name: What are the advantages of installing hardwood flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of installing hardwood flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardwood flooring offers durability, enhancing the value of your home, and is relatively easy to clean and maintain. It provides a timeless aesthetic that can complement various interior design styles. Unlike carpets, hardwood does not trap dust or allergens, contributing to better indoor air quality. With proper care, hardwood floors can last for decades, often outliving other flooring options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hardwood flooring offers durability, increases home value, is easy to clean, and provides a timeless aesthetic.
